app.name: Krishi Sahay
app.tagline: Grow the right crop, in the right amount, for a buyer near you.
lang.label: Language
f.name: Your name
f.pin_hint: Remember this PIN. You will need it to log in.
auth.phone_taken: This mobile number is already registered. Please log in.
auth.wrong: Mobile number or PIN is wrong.
loc.title: Where is your farm?
loc.gps_wait: Allow location in your browser, then press again.
loc.need: Please choose your village or use phone location.
p1.title: Your farm
p1.card: I have a Soil Health Card
p1.card_help: Type the numbers from your soil test report. Leave a box at 0 if it is not on your card. pH also decides which crops fit. The nutrient numbers are used for the fertilizer advice in your audio guide and in Ask. They do not change the crop ranking.
p1.risk: How much risk can you take?
p2.title: Best crops for your land
p2.climate: Your area this season: about {temp}°C, {rain} mm rain per month (average of last 3 years).
p2.climate_fail: Couldn't fetch weather, using typical values.
p2.none: No crop fits this land in this season. Try another season or ask your KVK.
p2.ask_kvk: Not sure? Call Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551 (free).
card.bad_loss: Bad year (worst of last 5): loss {x} per acre
card.bad_profit: Bad year (worst of last 5): {x} per acre
card.new: 🧪 New here — try on a small plot first
reason.price_crash: prices have crashed in some years
reason.bad_year_loss: you can lose money in a bad year
reason.price_swings: prices go up and down a lot
reason.steady: prices and yield are fairly steady
reason.too_many_planting: many farmers near you are planting this
reason.new_here: not commonly grown in your area
plan.title: How much to grow
warn.glut: 🚜 {n} acres of {crop} already planned near you
warn.one_crop: Most of your land is in {crop}. Spreading over 2–3 crops is safer.
warn.over_demand: You may grow more {crop} than buyers near you want ({q} quintal).
msg.saved: Saved ✔ Buyers near you will see total area planned (not your name).
buyer.title: Buyers near you (within 50 km)
buyer.none: No buyer has posted a need for these crops yet. Your saved plan helps buyers find you.
dlg.title: Confirm your promise
dlg.terms: You promise to give {crop} to {vendor} at ₹{price}/quintal, grade {grade}, between {from} and {to}. {pickup}.
dlg.qty: How many quintal can you give?
dlg.done: Done! Your reference code is {code}. Show it at delivery.
guide.title: Audio guide: how to grow, water and protect
guide.no_audio: Audio isn't available in this language yet, the written guide is below.
v.title: Post what you want to buy
v.min_days: Farmers need time to grow. A delivery window at least 60–90 days away gets more farmers.
v.need_price: Please enter a price. Farmers decide based on price.
v.posted: Posted! Farmers within 50 km will see it.
v.supply: Supply coming near you (farmers' saved plans, totals only)
v.supply_none: No farmer near you has saved a plan yet.
card.fl_note: Profit counts the value of your family's own labour as a cost.
reason.rough_numbers: figures for this crop are rough, check local prices before you decide
plan.est_note: Some crops in this plan use rough estimates. Treat the total as a guide, not a promise.
ask.title: Ask Krishi Sahay
ask.sub: Speak or type in your own language. I remember our chat and your farm.
ask.empty: I could not hear you. Please speak again, closer to the phone.
ask.error: Sorry, I could not answer right now. Please try again.
ask.privacy: Your chat is saved with your account so I can remember it. You can clear it any time.
ask.no_audio: Audio is not available in this language yet; please read the text above.
ask.kvk: For crop diseases or pesticides, also check with your KVK or Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551.
ask.welcome: Namaste! Ask me anything about your crops, water, prices or buyers.
ask.cap_no_mic: Voice input is not available for this language yet, so please type your question.
ask.cap_no_voice: The spoken reply is not available for this language yet; the answer is shown as text.
ask.cap_bhashini: (Adding a free Bhashini account turns on voice for all 22 languages.)
card.dry_years: 💧 Water-short in {n} of the last {total} seasons here
card.heavy_rain: 🌧️ Very heavy rain (115 mm+ in a day) hit {n} of the last {total} seasons
reason.dry_years: dry years are common here for this crop
p2.trend: Last {recent} seasons ({years}) vs earlier: rain {rain:+d}%, crop water demand {et0:+d}%.
plan.water_title: 💧 Water, power and CO₂ for your plan
plan.water_note: Simulated over the last {n} seasons at your farm, per season. Baseline = the usual number of flood irrigations on fixed dates. Pump assumptions: {head} m lift, {eff}% efficiency, grid CO₂ 0.727 kg/kWh. Replace with your own pump details for exact numbers.
plan.water_l1: Water by soil need (flood): {m3} m³ ({saved}), yield {y}%
plan.water_l2: Same plus drip/sprinkler: {m3} m³ ({saved}), {kwh} kWh, {co2} kg CO₂ ({saved_kwh} kWh less), yield {y}%
irrig.title: 🚿 Should I water today?
irrig.days: Days since sowing (0 if not sown yet)
irrig.last: Days since last watering (leave 0 if unknown)
irrig.wait: No watering needed in the next 7 days, based on the forecast.
irrig.rain: Rain chance in the next days: {p}% (max). Check the sky before you start the pump.
village.title: Village water and power
village.sub: Everyone's saved crop plans added up: how much irrigation water the village needs this season, the pumping power, and where a crop change would help.
village.budget: Water available for irrigation this season (m³)
village.budget_help: From your Water Security Plan or a local estimate. Leave 0 if unknown.
village.none: No farmer near here has saved a plan for this season yet.
village.demo: These plans are demo data, not real farmers.
village.over: ⚠️ Planned crops need {x} m³ more water than available in a usual year ({y} m³ more in a dry year).
village.tight: ⚠️ Enough water in a usual year, but {y} m³ short in a dry year.
village.ok: ✅ Enough water even in a dry year.
village.shift: Where a crop change would save water
village.shift_line: Replacing {a} with {b} saves about {m3} m³ per acre, and changes profit by {rs} per acre (usual year).
village.note: Demand is simulated from past weather for each crop on the farmer's water supply (pump assumptions: {head} m lift, {eff}% efficiency). Rain-only land adds no pumping.
pump.title: ⚙️ Right-size your pump and solar payback
pump.hours: Hours of power or sun per day
pump.hours_help: Maharashtra promises 8 hours of daytime power on farm feeders.
pump.head: Water lift (m)
pump.result: For {acres} acre at the peak of the crop ({peak} mm per day) you need about {m3} m³ per day. Smallest suitable pump: {hp} HP, with about {kwp} kWp of solar panels if you go solar.
pump.assume: Sizing assumes 35% pump efficiency and 1.25 kWp of panels per kW of pump power. Ask your supplier to confirm.
pump.oversized: Your {cur} HP pump is bigger than the {hp} HP this crop needs. A smaller pump can save electricity or diesel.
pump.payback_help: Enter your own prices. Standalone solar pumps under PM-KUSUM typically get 60% subsidy (30% central + 30% state); you pay 40%. Confirm with your state agency.
pump.payback_result: You pay {own} (subsidy {sub}). Saves about {save} a year. Payback about {yrs} years. Avoids about {co2} kg CO₂ a year.
home.title: What do you want to do?
wat.title: Water and energy
wat.sub: Pick your crop and water. See the forecast, what past seasons were like, how much water and power you can save, pump size, and keep your own pump log.
wat.rain_only: This land has no irrigation water, so there is nothing to schedule. Choose a water option above to see watering advice.
wat.rel_note: Yield compared with a season with no water shortage, simulated for each of the last {n} seasons at your farm.
wat.chart_yield: Yield each past season (100% = no water shortage)
wat.irrig_need: Watering needed in a usual year: about {mm} mm in about {n} waterings (dry year: {p90} mm).
wat.cmp_note: Median of the last {n} seasons, per season. 'Usual practice' = {k} flood waterings on fixed dates.
wat.more_water_note: More water here means the usual practice leaves the crop short of water. The schedule protects the yield instead of saving water.
wat.enter_prices: Enter your electricity or diesel price and the quoted solar cost to see payback.
log.sub: Write down each time you run the pump. After a season you will see your real power and diesel use, and can compare it with the plan.
log.vs_plan: For {acres} acre of {crop}: usual practice about {base} kWh a season, watering by need about {sched} kWh. You have logged {mine} kWh so far.
p2.rain_range: Rain in a {n}-season record at your farm over this crop season: dry year {dry} mm, usual {usual} mm, wet year {wet} mm.
p2.forecast: Next {days} days: about {rain} mm rain expected, highest daily rain chance {p}%.
p1.card_where: Have a Soil Health Card? Open the box below and copy the ratings from it. If you don't have one, skip it.
p1.card_get: No card yet? Ask at your agriculture office, Krishi Vigyan Kendra or soil-testing lab. You can also look up or download your card at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
loc.detecting: 📡 Finding your location… please tap Allow when your browser asks.
loc.denied: Could not get GPS (permission off or no signal). Using your saved location. You can change it below.
loc.coords_help: Or type the coordinates of your field (for example from Google Maps: long-press your field and copy the two numbers).
loc.save_profile: 💾 Save as my farm's location (updates buyers within 50 km)
loc.saved_profile: Saved. Your buyer groups within 50 km have been updated.
ask.untranslated: Translation is busy right now, so this answer is in English. Please try again in a few minutes.
guide.untranslated: Translation is busy right now, so this guide is in English. Please try again in a few minutes.
p1.card_note: The Low / Medium / High shown is approximate, because limits differ by lab and state. If your card prints its own rating, trust the card.
soil.mode: How do you want to give soil details?
soil.mode_map: I have no soil test: estimate from my location
soil.reading: Reading the soil map for your location…
soil.map_title: Estimated from satellite soil maps for your location
soil.map_note: A modelled estimate for a 250 m area, not a measurement of your own field. Nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium cannot be read from a map: for fertilizer advice, use a soil test.
soil.map_fail: Could not read the soil map for this spot (no data, or the service is busy). Pick your soil type under 'Change soil type' below, or enter soil test numbers.
soil.using_map: Using soil pH {ph} and water-holding capacity {taw} mm per metre from the satellite estimate.
soil.using_test: Using the pH from your soil test ({ph}); water-holding capacity {taw} mm per metre.
soil.using_type: Using the soil type you chose: pH {ph}, water-holding capacity {taw} mm per metre.
soil.using_default: No soil data available: using typical pH {ph} and water-holding capacity {taw} mm per metre.
p1.sow: Date you plan to start sowing
p1.sow_help: Sowing date matters: the same crop can do well or fail depending on when rain and water arrive.
p2.sowing_line: Sowing from {date} ({season} season). All risk and water numbers below use this date.
p2.prices_loading: Fetching today's market prices in the background. Stored five-year prices are used until they arrive.
p2.prices_live: Market prices refreshed live from Agmarknet for {n} crops.
p2.prices_stored: Using stored five-year market prices (the live price service is not answering right now).
home.refreshed: Done. The next screen will fetch fresh weather, soil and price data.
home.refresh_help: The app keeps a saved copy of weather (15 minutes to 6 hours), soil (7 days) and prices (12 hours) so screens open fast. This button throws those copies away.
farm.none: You have not chosen any crops yet. Start with What to grow, pick your crops and save your plan.
farm.not_sown: Not sown yet: sowing in {n} days.
farm.system_none: Tell us how you irrigate. We use it to size watering and power for your schedule.
farm.system_note: Typical efficiencies (flood 60%, sprinkler 75%, drip 90%) and a 35% efficient pump are assumed. Change the pump and lift to match yours.
farm.sched_none: No watering schedule yet: it needs a saved crop on watered land with a sowing date.
farm.sched_wait: Building your schedule from your sowing date…
farm.no_more_water: No more watering needed for this crop on the current outlook.
farm.sched_typical_only: Live weather could not be fetched, so dates use a typical year only.
farm.sched_basis: Dates up to a few days ago use observed weather, the next {n} days use the forecast, and later dates assume a typical year ({y} pattern). They will shift as real weather arrives.
farm.sched_note: Assumes {eff}% of the water applied reaches the crop, and no single watering deeper than {cap} mm in the soil. Adjust with your own experience.
farm.log_help: Your real waterings replace the plan for those days, and the next dates update.
sell.sub: All buyers within 50 km that want crops in the coming months. Compare, then commit your quantity.
sell.none: No buyer within 50 km has an open need right now. Check again soon, or save your crop plan so buyers can find you.
sell.you_plan: You plan about {q} quintal of this crop.
wat.weather_busy: The weather service is busy right now and this part could not load. Please try again in a few minutes.
reason.off_season: usually sown in another season; the weather and water check passes for your sowing date, but prices and yield are for the usual season
